## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 6 ago 2026 - 11 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Samanticss_, 11 sept 2026, 1/5: "The ONLY thing that kept me opening the app and checking off tasks every day was to try and get the month’s micropet. Now it’s behind a $40-120 paywall… and the main feature of every screen is many lock graphics🔒. I used to be a paid user but fell on hard times. I guess that means I deserve progressively worse service from a self care app I’ve used almost every day for three years. Squeezing from both ends with all these corporate sponsors too… and I heard you’re not good to your designers. Sell out. Edit: putting custom symbols for tasks behind a paywall is honestly ableist. And the message is so vague…like custom icons on a list are one of the most basic features. And every time I click to do it, a nonspecific add to pay $40 for an app I’ve used almost every day for 5 years. I used this to help me through my day. I can’t believe you took away such basic features with no warning or community note…"
            2. _Mr. T-Wrecks_, 10 sept 2026, 3/5: "I like the app. It has helped me stay focused and productive throughout the day. The only thing that really bothers me is the Shop items. If you’re a Free user, you only get 8 options in Outfit and Furniture to choose from (16 with the free re-roll). But the options are the worst options—they’re typically the most boring/generic options, and they follow the same pattern every time. All the good options require Finch Plus. Why? Free users are earning the same points in the same way as any user on Finch Plus. The items are already behind one “paywall” (in-game currency). Why put them behind two? Additionally, and maybe even more problematic, is that every item has multiple colors and each color is a different item. So if you see a hat you want but it’s in a color you don’t want, well, too bad. You’ll have to hope it comes up in the color you want. This is ridiculous. Just have items and let us pick whatever color we want! The current way is designed to be exploitive—on a self-care app!"
            3. _mysticalgamer666_, 6 ago 2026, 4/5: "Makes cleaning and self care fun. The only problems i have with it is that, majority of items are either too expensive, or locked behind Finch Plus. For people like me who can’t afford £50 a year, it makes it somewhat inaccessible."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Presión publicitaria** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Presión publicitaria.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona presión publicitaria.
      Ventana de reseñas: 10 sept 2026 - 10 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios notan presión publicitaria. Señala fricción de monetización y una apertura para un competidor más limpio.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _spudd122_, 10 sept 2026, 4/5: "I’ve really loved this app for over 2 years now. It’s been helpful for building good habits and staying on top of self-care and mental health. However, the month long events turning into a month long advertisement for an upcoming movie every few months is getting annoying and old quick. I understand this app is free, but forcing month long ads on your customers shouldn’t be the way to pay for it. Ads annoy people and they’ll stop using your product to avoid them."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 28 may 2026 - 2 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Landorous_, 2 sept 2026, 1/5: "This whole event is a glitchy mess. I can’t imagine how bad the movie will be. This applies to all."
            2. _anonymousical_, 2 sept 2026, 1/5: "trying to charge me almost $40 after i deleted the app for a plan i never chose and now i can’t even download any apps until i pay for the yearly plan for a useless and pointless app just so i can download other apps. 1 star all the way. never has had this issue before until one. if i can give a zero rating i would. useless and money hungry people and app"
            3. _plantguyhome_, 28 may 2026, 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
<!--/ir-theme-->
